name: GPROXY
description: Self-hosted LLM API gateway with a web console and PostgreSQL persistence.

GPROXY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Administrator login password. Save the generated value from Settings > Config Vars.

GPROXY_MASTER_KEY.description: 32-byte encryption key: run openssl rand -hex 32 and paste the 64 hex characters. Keep this key across redeploys.
